title: fisc fact record
description: One figure the city printed, at a page and an offset of a source PDF. One record per line of facts/facts.jsonl and of the published dist/facts/<doc_id>/pages/pNNNN.jsonl shards. Nothing computed goes in here; see AGENTS.md, "A forecast is not a fact".

id.description: Content-addressed over (doc_id, rule_id, row_path, row_label, column_path, fiscal_year, basis).

page.description: 1-based page of the source PDF, which is also the shard this record ships in.

offset.description: Byte offset into the extracted page text at which token begins. fact-offset-points-at-token holds it.

token.description: The characters the page prints. Never empty: an empty token is a figure no page carries.

fund.description: The fund number the column names, and null where it names none. NULL IS NOT 0: a schedule with no fund axis and a row whose fund does not resolve are both real absences.

sign.description: How this row relates to its category. NOT an instruction to negate: amount_cents is always the figure as printed.

units.description: The unit the PAGE printed in. amount_cents is always cents regardless.

amount_cents.description: Integer cents. No float reaches this field; see AGENTS.md, "Provenance invariants".

derived.description: A re-reading or re-classification of a figure the city printed, never a computed value.
